metadata.description: LeadLens: a TL's lens for reviewing code, architecture and implementation.

plugins.name: leadlens
plugins.description: Weekly and monthly engineering reports from GitHub, a fast pre-merge review skill, a Lead Lens audit with gates and a ship verdict, a plain-English code audit report of one author's commits across branches or of one branch before merge, and a secrets-blocking hook, for Team Leads and PMs.
